Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Talyn Sorek: 18-year-old woman, 198 cm (very-tall), unmistakably soft rounded construction with a clearly evident, naturally wider middle, short-to-average limbs, no cinched or flat waist, and gentle limb contours, skin value band-5-medium-deep. Face: angular diamond face; high cheekbones and softly lidded eyes; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: gray-white-silver, bob-pageboy, deliberate accent: one longer face-framing section. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges; bounded palette plum-gray. Visible personal details: a dense freckle field. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: uses small rhythmic repeats of the palette. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a palm-sized map roll only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
